name: Equitas Small Finance Bank
tagline: Chennai-based small finance bank with weak current profitability (ROE ~2.5%, ROCE ~4.6%) due to ongoing microfinance-book stress; a Universal Bank licence bid was explicitly paused in 2026 to study peer (Ujjivan/Jana) rejections rather than pursued as a live catalyst - no confirmed named inflection found. Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@investor_vineet, bullish, very-high conviction).
business_overview: Equitas SFB serves financially underserved segments (microfinance, vehicle finance, MSME, affordable housing) with a bank licence since 2016. It has been reducing its microfinance-advances mix (12% -> 9% of total advances between Mar 2025 and Jun 2025) to manage asset-quality stress in that segment, while also being eligible (on NPA ratios) to apply for a Universal Bank licence - a step it has so far paused rather than pursued.
fundamentals_table: Net NPA ~0.92%, Gross NPA ~2.75% - within Universal Bank licence eligibility thresholds
fundamentals_narrative: Current profitability is weak (ROE ~2.5%, ROCE ~4.6%, P/E ~79x on a depressed earnings base) - explained by elevated credit costs and write-offs in the microfinance book, which the bank has been actively shrinking as a share of total advances (12% to 9% within a few months). Asset quality ratios (sub-1% net NPA, sub-3% gross NPA) technically clear the RBI bar for a Universal Bank licence application, but management has explicitly paused that bid to study why peers Ujjivan and Jana were rejected - this is a live risk being managed down, not a confirmed named inflection to underwrite a bullish thesis on.
